import itertools

def solve_small_n_exhaustive(n):
    matches = list(itertools.combinations(range(n), 2))
    num_matches = len(matches)
    min_cost = float('inf')
    
    for p in itertools.permutations(matches):
        first = [float('inf')] * n
        last = [float('-inf')] * n
        for day, match in enumerate(p, 1):
            u, v = match
            first[u] = min(first[u], day)
            first[v] = min(first[v], day)
            last[u] = max(last[u], day)
            last[v] = max(last[v], day)
        
        cost = sum(last[i] - first[i] + 1 for i in range(n))
        if cost < min_cost:
            min_cost = cost
    return min_cost

print(f"n=5, min_cost={solve_small_n_exhaustive(5)}")

    # Player n
